metadata.title: Deers Rock v0.5.0 - Research Artifact for JAMIA 2026 Manuscript
metadata.description: Frozen research artifact accompanying the JAMIA 2026 manuscript 'Deers Rock: A Deterministic Micro-Simulation of a Tier A Referral Hospital in Eastern Indonesia'. Contains the final manuscript, the frozen E1 baseline experiment artifacts (10 seeds x 1,000 ticks: length of stay 82.9 +/- 10.4, deaths 4.3 +/- 1.9, mean peak bed occupancy 130.9 of 133 beds (98%), 2/10 disaster-triggered runs), the experiment freeze record, and reproducibility documentation. Deers Rock is an open-source (Apache-2.0) deterministic, seeded healthcare micro-simulation; all clinical parameters are plausibility-based and uncalibrated, and the work makes no clinical-validity or predictive claims.
